title: 2.1. An Overview of Data Science 🧠
content:
What is Data Science?
Data science is a multi-disciplinary field that uses scientific methods, processes, algorithms, and systems to extract knowledge and insights from structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data. It is much more than simply analyzing data; it requires a range of roles and skills.

The Role of a Data Scientist:
Data scientists must master the full spectrum of the data science life cycle. They need to be curious, result-oriented, and possess exceptional communication skills to explain highly technical results to non-technical counterparts. They must have a strong quantitative background in statistics and linear algebra, as well as programming knowledge focusing on data warehousing, mining, and modeling.

👉 ዳታ ሳይንስ ማለት የተስተካከለ፣ በከፊል የተስተካከለ እና ያልተስተካከለ ዳታን በመጠቀም ሳይንሳዊ በሆነ መንገድ ጠቃሚ እውቀትንና መረጃን የማውጣት ጥበብ ነው። አንድ ስኬታማ የዳታ ሳይንቲስት በስታቲስቲክስ፣ በሒሳብ (Linear algebra) እና በኮምፒውተር ፕሮግራሚንግ ከፍተኛ እውቀት ሊኖረው ይገባል። በተጨማሪም ያገኘውን ቴክኒካዊ ውጤት ለሌሎች ሰዎች በቀላሉ የማስረዳት ችሎታ (Communication skills) ማዳበር አለበት።

title: 2.1.1. What are Data and Information? 📄 vs 💡
content:
Data:
Data can be defined as a representation of facts, concepts, or instructions in a formalized manner suitable for communication, interpretation, or processing by humans or electronic machines. It represents unprocessed facts and figures. It is represented using alphabets (A-Z, a-z), digits (0-9), or special characters (+, -, *, /).

Information:
Information is the processed data on which decisions and actions are based. It is data that has been processed into a form that is meaningful to the recipient and has real or perceived value for current or future actions. Simply put, information is interpreted data created from organized, structured, and processed data in a particular context.

👉 ዳታ (Data) ማለት ገና ያልተሰራበት፣ ያልተተነተነ እና በራሱ የተሟላ ትርጉም የማይሰጥ ጥሬ መረጃ ነው። በፊደላት፣ በቁጥሮች ወይም በምልክቶች ሊገለጽ ይችላል። በሌላ በኩል ኢንፎርሜሽን (Information) ማለት ተተንትኖ፣ ተደራጅቶና ትርጉም አግኝቶ ለውሳኔ መስጫ ዝግጁ የሆነ ጠቃሚ መረጃ ማለት ነው።

🎯 Exam Hint: Data = Unprocessed facts. Information = Processed data used for decisions!

title: 2.1.2. Data Processing Cycle 🔄
content:
The Data Processing Cycle
Data processing is the re-structuring or re-ordering of data by people or machines to increase their usefulness and add value for a particular purpose. This cycle consists of three basic steps:

1. Input: The input data is prepared in a convenient form for processing. When using computers, input data can be recorded on storage mediums like hard disks, CDs, or flash disks.
2. Processing: The input data is changed to produce data in a more useful form. For example, calculating interest on a bank deposit or summarizing monthly sales orders.
3. Output: The result of the processing step is collected. The form of the output depends on its intended use, such as generating a payroll for employees.

👉 ዳታን ወደ ጠቃሚ ኢንፎርሜሽን የመቀየር ሂደት ሦስት ዋና ዋና ደረጃዎች አሉት። መጀመሪያ ጥሬ ዳታውን በተለያዩ መሳሪያዎች አማካኝነት ወደ ኮምፒውተር ማስገባት (Input)፣ በመቀጠል ዳታውን ማስላት ወይም ማቀናበር (Processing)፣ በመጨረሻም የተሰራበትን መረጃ ለተጠቃሚው በሚገባ መልኩ ማውጣት (Output) ናቸው።

title: 2.3.1. Data Types (Computer Programming Perspective) 💻
content:
Programming Data Types
In computer science, a data type is an attribute of data that tells the compiler or interpreter how the programmer intends to use the data. Common data types include:

• Integers (int): Used to store whole numbers (e.g., 5, -10).
• Booleans (bool): Restricted to one of two values: true or false.
• Characters (char): Used to store a single character (e.g., 'A', '$').
• Floating-point numbers (float): Used to store real numbers with decimal points (e.g., 3.14).
• Alphanumeric strings (string): Used to store a combination of characters and numbers (e.g., "EthioFresh").

👉 በፕሮግራሚንግ አለም ውስጥ ዳታ ታይፕ ኮምፒውተሩ ዳታውን እንዴት መጠቀም እንዳለበት ይነግረዋል። ሙሉ ቁጥሮችን ለመያዝ (Integer)፣ እውነት/ሀሰት ለማለት (Boolean)፣ አንዲት ፊደል ብቻ ለመያዝ (Character)፣ ነጥብ ያላቸውን ቁጥሮች ለመያዝ (Float) እንዲሁም የጽሑፍ ሀሳቦችን ለመያዝ ደግሞ (String) እንጠቀማለን።

title: 2.3.2. Data Types (Data Analytics Perspective) 📊
content:
Analytics Data Structures
From a data analytics point of view, there are three common data structures, plus metadata:

• Structured Data: Adheres to a pre-defined data model (tabular format with rows and columns). It is straightforward to analyze. Examples: Excel files, SQL databases.
• Semi-structured Data: Does not conform to formal tabular structures but contains tags or markers to separate elements and enforce hierarchies (self-describing). Examples: JSON, XML.
• Unstructured Data: Has no predefined data model. It is typically text-heavy, irregular, and ambiguous, making it difficult for traditional programs to understand. Examples: Audio, video files, No-SQL databases.
• Metadata: Data about data. It provides additional information about a specific dataset (e.g., the time and location a photograph was taken).

👉 በዳታ ትንተና (Analytics) ጊዜ ዳታ በ 3 ይከፈላል። ግልጽ የሆነ የሰንጠረዥ ቅርፅ ያለው እና ለመተንተን ቀላል የሆነው (Structured data)፣ የተወሰነ ቅርፅ ባይኖረውም መለያ ታጎች (Tags) ያሉት (Semi-structured data)፣ እና ምንም አይነት አደረጃጀት የሌላቸው እንደ ድምፅ እና ቪዲዮ ፋይሎች ያሉት (Unstructured data) ይባላሉ። Metadata ማለት ደግሞ ስለ ዋናው ዳታ ተጨማሪ ማብራሪያ የሚሰጥ መረጃ ማለት ነው።

title: 2.4. Data Value Chain ⛓️
content:
The Big Data Value Chain
The Data Value Chain describes the information flow within a big data system required to generate useful insights. It involves five key activities:

1. Data Acquisition: Gathering, filtering, and cleaning data before storing it. It requires an infrastructure that handles high transaction volumes with low latency.
2. Data Analysis: Exploring, transforming, and modeling raw data into decision-making tools using data mining, BI, and machine learning.
3. Data Curation: The active management of data over its life cycle to ensure trustworthiness, accessibility, and quality. It is performed by expert curators (annotators).
4. Data Storage: Scalable management of data. Traditional RDBMS (ACID properties) lack flexibility for big data, making NoSQL technologies the preferred alternative.
5. Data Usage: Integrating data insights into business activities to reduce costs and increase competitiveness.

👉 ይሄ ማለት ዳታ እንዴት ወደ ቢዝነስ እሴትነት እንደሚቀየር የሚያሳይ የ 5 ደረጃዎች ጉዞ ነው። ዳታውን መሰብሰብና ማጽዳት፣ ለውሳኔ በሚመች መልኩ መተንተን፣ ጥራቱን ጠብቆ መንከባከብ (ይህ ብዙ የሰው ጉልበት የሚጠይቅ ነው)፣ መረጃውን በ NoSQL ቴክኖሎጂዎች ማከማቸት፣ እና በመጨረሻም የቢዝነስ ትርፋማነትን ለማሳደግ ስራ ላይ ማዋል ናቸው።

title: 2.5.1. What Is Big Data? (The 4 V's) 🌐
content:
Understanding Big Data
Big data is a collection of datasets so large and complex that it becomes difficult to process using on-hand database management tools or single computers. The scale of "big" shifts continuously depending on computing power. Big data is characterized by the following dimensions:

• Volume: Massive datasets (large amounts of data, e.g., Zettabytes).
• Velocity: Data is live streaming, generated, and moving at high speeds.
• Variety: Data comes in many different forms and from diverse sources.
• Veracity: The accuracy, trustworthiness, and quality of the data.

👉 ቢግ ዳታ (Big Data) ማለት በተለመዱት የኮምፒውተር ሶፍትዌሮች እና በአንድ ኮምፒውተር ብቻ ለማቀናበር የማይቻሉ እጅግ በጣም ግዙፍና ውስብስብ የሆኑ የመረጃ ስብስቦች ናቸው። ዋና መገለጫዎቹም፡ እጅግ ግዙፍ መጠን (Volume)፣ እጅግ ፈጣን የዳታ ፍሰት (Velocity)፣ የተለያዩ የዳታ አይነቶች ስብጥር (Variety) እና የዳታው ተአማኒነት (Veracity) ናቸው።

title: 2.5.2. Clustered Computing 🖥️
content:
Why Clustered Computing?
Because of the massive nature of big data, individual computers are inadequate. Computer clusters (combining the resources of many smaller machines) are a better fit. Clusters provide:

1. Resource Pooling: Combining available storage space, CPU, and memory across multiple machines.
2. High Availability: Fault tolerance guarantees that hardware or software failures won't affect access to data or processing.
3. Easy Scalability: Clusters scale horizontally by adding more physical machines easily when resource requirements expand.

Cluster membership and resource allocation are managed by software like Hadoop’s YARN (Yet Another Resource Negotiator).

👉 አንድ ግለሰብ ኮምፒውተር ቢግ ዳታን አቅም ስለማይኖረው፣ በርካታ አነስተኛ ኮምፒውተሮችን በአንድ ላይ በማስተሳሰር (Cluster) እንጠቀማለን። የዚህም ጥቅም፡ የሁሉንም ኮምፒውተር አቅም አንድ ላይ ለመጠቀም፣ አንዱ ሲበላሽ ሌላው ስራውን እንዲቀጥል ለማድረግ፣ እንዲሁም አቅም ሲያንሰን በቀላሉ ሌላ ኮምፒውተር ለመጨመር ያስችለናል።

title: 2.5.2. Hadoop and its Ecosystem 🐘
content:
What is Hadoop?
Hadoop is an open-source framework inspired by Google that allows for the distributed processing of large datasets across clusters of computers using simple programming models. Its key characteristics are:
• Economical: Ordinary computers can be used.
• Reliable: Stores copies of data on different machines, resisting hardware failure.
• Scalable: Easily scalable horizontally.
• Flexible: Stores both structured and unstructured data.

Hadoop Ecosystem Components:
• HDFS: Distributed file storage.
• YARN: Resource management.
• MapReduce & Spark: Data processing (Spark is In-Memory and faster).
• PIG & HIVE: Query-based processing.
• HBase: NoSQL Database.

👉 ሃዱፕ (Hadoop) ቢግ ዳታን በተለያዩ የተሳሰሩ ኮምፒውተሮች ላይ ከፋፍሎ በቀላሉ ለማስቀመጥና ለማቀናበር የሚያገለግል ሲስተም ነው። ርካሽ ነው፣ አይበላሽም (ዳታን ስለሚያባዛ)፣ በቀላሉ ያድጋል፣ እንዲሁም ማንኛውንም የዳታ አይነት ይቀበላል። በውስጡም ዳታ ማከማቻ (HDFS)፣ ማቀናበሪያ (Spark/MapReduce) እና ዳታ ቤዝ (HBase) የመሳሰሉትን አካትቶ ይዟል።

title: 2.5.3. Big Data Life Cycle with Hadoop 🔄
content:
The Four Stages of Big Data Processing

1. Ingesting data into the system: Data is transferred to Hadoop from various sources. Sqoop transfers relational data (RDBMS) to HDFS, while Flume transfers event data.
2. Processing the data in storage: Data is stored in HDFS and HBase (NoSQL). Processing is performed by Spark and MapReduce.
3. Computing and analyzing data: Data is analyzed using frameworks like Pig, Hive, and Impala. Hive is highly suitable for structured data analysis.
4. Visualizing the results: The analyzed data is accessed by users through visualization tools like Hue and Cloudera Search.

👉 ቢግ ዳታ በሃዱፕ ውስጥ የሚያልፍባቸው 4 ደረጃዎች፦ መጀመሪያ ዳታውን ወደ ሃዱፕ ሲስተም ማስገባት (Ingest)፣ በመቀጠል የተቀበልነውን ዳታ ማከማቸትና በኮድ መስራት (Process)፣ ከዚያም ዳታውን ወደ ጠቃሚ መረጃነት መተንተን (Analyze)፣ እና በመጨረሻም ውጤቱን ለተጠቃሚው ማሳየትና ማቅረብ (Visualize) ናቸው።
